payload.answer: Add a way to run several named jobs concurrently -- e.g. `vibey work --parallel <id>,<id>,<id>` -- with a mechanism that stops them colliding while they work against the same branch. BEFORE designing any of that, resolve one question, because it determines whether this is a small feature or a hard one: vibey ALREADY runs jobs concurrently. Workers claim with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, hold per-kind leases, work in separate git worktrees under .vibey/worktrees/<cycle>/, and serialise the merge step behind an advisory lock (the 'advisory-locked integrates' in the architecture notes). So the honest first task is to state precisely what this command adds that `vibey worker -j N` does not.
